rounds.text: Reliable Data Services Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a margin of safety calculated at 61.3% [E45]. The company demonstrates robust operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROA of 4.95% and an ROE of 9.63%, both of which substantially outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E8, E9]. This performance is supported by strong long-term growth, with compounded sales growth reaching 22% over the last decade and accelerating to 37% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E17]. Furthermore, the stock is attractively priced relative to its peers, trading at a P/E of 15.87x compared to the sector benchmark of 19.68x, and an EV/EBITDA of 9.71x against the sector's 13.46x [E6, E11]. The company’s financial health is bolstered by effective cash management, as profits are fully backed by cash with a conversion ratio of 1.57x [E33]. Conceded: the company faces headwinds from a decline in promoter holding [E41], a recent contraction in operating margins [E29, E30], and a negative compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21]. Despite these challenges, the rules-based screen assigns the company a score of 80 out of 100, reflecting a medium-confidence buy signal driven by strong top-line momentum [E64, E65].
